messages:
elaine: Thinking out loud: what if rollout metadata supported 'componentized' bindings where a route declares an explicit map of roles -> model (e.g., embedder, generator, reranker)? This gives us minimal-rollout combos and smaller blast radii.

noah: I like it. Key contract question: how does the resolver expose the choice to callers so cached model ids don't silently become stale? We should return a binding_version token and an exploded list of resolved ids in a header.

zane: Concrete resolver header idea: `X-Rwd-Resolved: embedder=rwd-emb-v4;generator=rwd-gen-v3;bind-v=20260401`. SDKs re-resolve on bind-v change. Also add `bind_ttl` so caches know how long to keep resolved mapping.

vik: From ops: migration must be additive. Plan: 1) Introduce component bindings as an optional overlay. 2) Run backfill dry-run to compute diffs for active routes. 3) Launch canaries (2-10% traffic) with per-component evals. 4) Auto-fallback if eval or latency thresholds fail.

elaine: Schema notions to discuss: per_component.compat_range, per_component.stability_hint (0-1), per_component.precision_family (e.g., q4_0, fp16). Also a top-level binding_policy that indicates whether tenant overrides are allowed.

noah: Deprecation semantics: add soft_deprecate boolean + soft_until date per component. Default soft windows: 90d for non-breaking, 30d for patches, immediate for security. Make configurable per binding.

zane: CLI plan: `redwoodctl bind --scope route --route /items --component embedder=rwd-emb-v4` and `redwoodctl migrate-bindings --dry-run --report`. Ops will own rollout automation and dry-run reports.

deploy-bot: canary: created for /items components {embedder:rwd-emb-v4, generator:rwd-gen-v3} at 5%. id=canary-6123. Metrics: latency, error-rate, quality-eval queued.

elaine: Edge-cases: mixed precision families (client capacity mismatch)  resolver should prefer compatible family or return an alternate list with reasons. Also per-component rollbacks so a bad reranker doesn't force generator rollback.

noah: Action items: I'll sketch resolver response + header spec. zane please draft the migration dry-run and runbook. elaine will open the mini-RFC and examples. We'll aim to land the schema as an additive opt-in change so existing bindings keep working. :+1:
